text:
Rhea (People Ops): Heads-up: were publishing a family-formation benefits update today. Key points: 1) fertility and adoption stipend increased to $6,000 lifetime cap (was $4,000); 2) new Adoption Travel Reimbursement up to $2,000 for overseas adoptions; 3) a small Backup Care pool (on-call vouchers) for same-day caregiver gaps (pilot, limited slots). Full details + request forms: https://intranet.redwood/people/family-formation-2026. Please read if this applies to you. :heart:

Sam (Benefits): Quick clarifier  the $6k stipend is per-employee lifetime and covers eligible medical procedures, storage, and related counseling. The Adoption Travel Reimbursement is separate and processed as an expense (attach travel receipts).

Ivy (Manager): A team member has a pending adoption trip next month  do we apply for the travel reimbursement retroactively if they already booked?

Maya (People Ops): Yes  retroactive reimbursements allowed for travel that started after Jan 1, 2026. Submit receipts with the Adoption Travel form and mark "retroactive". We'll fast-track approvals for adoption cases.

Keon (Eng): Any eligibility limits for contractors?

Rhea (People Ops): Contractors are not eligible for the stipend or the adoption travel reimbursement. The Backup Care pilot may allow contractor access on a case-by-case basis; managers should request slots via the pilot form.

CareBot: Backup Care pilot launched: 30 vouchers available per quarter. Use `/care status` to check availability. Pilot details: https://intranet.redwood/people/backup-care-pilot. Commands: `/care request <date>` `/care status`.

Sam (Benefits): One admin note: adoption travel reimbursements need a short confirmation letter from the adopting agency or legal rep (we don't require sensitive medical details). Finance will process once docs and receipts are uploaded. Expect ~2 pay cycles.

Ivy (Manager): Thank you  passing to my direct report and HRBP. Appreciate the retroactive allowance.

Rhea (People Ops): Office hours Q&A later today 11:00 PT for anyone who wants help with forms or has a complex case. We understand timing can be tight for adoption, so reach out and we'll triage. We'll pin the policy doc in People Ops after the session. :pushpin:
